name: @domains/feed
description: The new-domain feed: rows of the feed and new-name datasets built from the exact join and the hourly filter, their confidence and suspect rules, the optional time copy (the rows in first_seen order, docs/format.md section 14), the window planner over the live set, and the reader that pages rows in first_seen order from the time copy or the key copy. Runs in Node and in workerd alike.
